name: Yost Foods
old_description: At Yost Foods, we’re a family-owned ingredient manufacturer that’s been creating custom dry and wet ingredient systems on an industrial scale since 1991. We work side by side with food manufacturers to take products from initial concept through to consistent, reliable production.
about:
Yost Foods operates from Brunswick, Ohio, where it was founded in 1991 by Bill Yost as an industrial food brokerage. The family-owned company transitioned into custom ingredient manufacturing to meet customer demand for greater flexibility and dependable supply at scale.

Today the facility runs multiple production rooms separated for dry, wet, and kettle-cooking processes. Core capabilities include liquid mixing for sauces and marinades, ribbon and paddle mixing for dry blends, and kettle cooking for bases, caramelized sugars, purees, and pepper blends. High-volume capacity and smart automation support scalable production, with packaging options ranging from bags and bag-in-box to drums, pails, and totes.

The company serves national food manufacturers across categories such as sauces, dressings, and marinades; refrigerated and ready-to-eat foods; frozen meals and pizzas; snacks, candy, and nuts; and ice cream and frozen desserts. Yost works directly with R&D teams, food scientists, and culinary innovators from concept through commercial launch.

A family-owned, long-term mindset drives the company's differentiation: collaborative development that ensures performance in real production, fast sampling and rapid revisions, repeatable batches with process control, and guidance for clean-label certifications including kosher, organic, gluten-free, and non-GMO. The quality program maintains an SQF Excellent rating and a regulatory department focused on documentation.
